logic.note: Answers on I2C at 0x3C/0x3D and decodes the SSD1306 control-byte framing and command set: horizontal, vertical and page addressing, column/page ranges, contrast, normal/inverse, entire-display-on, display on/off, charge pump, start line, display offset, segment remap, COM scan direction, COM pin configuration and multiplex ratio. The screen shows exactly what is in display RAM after those transforms.

timing.note: Bytes take real I2C time (set by the MCU's TWI clock), but the panel shows a new frame instantly: no refresh rate, no tearing, and the clock/pre-charge settings (0xD5, 0xD9, 0xDB) have no effect.

analog.note: Contrast is shown as a simple brightness scale. No OLED burn-in, no brightness difference between few and many lit pixels.

power.note: Draws a fixed 10 mA from VCC (real modules use about 8 to 25 mA depending on how many pixels are lit) and only works between 2.8 and 5.5 V. 4.7 kOhm pull-ups on SDA and SCL to VCC.

emulates: I2C address 0x3C or 0x3D (address prop), ACK/NACK, and the status byte on reads
Co/D-C# control bytes, including one-command-per-control-byte streams
Memory addressing modes 0x20 (horizontal, vertical, page) with 0x21/0x22 ranges and wrap-around
Page-mode pointers 0xB0-0xB7, 0x00-0x0F and 0x10-0x1F (also honoured in horizontal mode, as U8g2 relies on)
Display on/off 0xAE/0xAF and the charge pump 0x8D: without 0x8D 0x14 the panel stays dark, like a real module
Start line 0x40-0x7F, display offset 0xD3, segment remap 0xA0/0xA1, COM scan 0xC0/0xC8, COM pins 0xDA, multiplex ratio 0xA8
A power loss clears the controller: the sketch must initialise it again
doesNotEmulate: Scrolling: 0x26/0x27/0x29/0x2A/0x2F are accepted but the image does not move
The SPI version of the module and the parallel interfaces
Refresh timing, flicker and the frame rate limit of the panel
Pixel-count dependent current and OLED ageing
testOnRealDevice: Which address your module really uses (check the jumper on the back; some are labelled 0x78/0x7A, which is 0x3C/0x3D shifted left)
Readability of the contrast setting in daylight
Supply current if you run from a battery
